note: The history of the construction of the statue of Christ on Núi Nhỏ (Tao Phùng), Vũng Tàu, from the web on 2026-11-10 (plan 0006). Each fact names its sources; the sources do not agree on some dates, and each such fact says so. The method 1974 of the statue (plan 0006, D3) takes its stages, its change and its site from these facts. A value with no source is an estimate, marked with "estimate". Each stage has its work for the method 1974 ("work": build, pause or change): a build makes the nodes of "until" and the nodes they wait for ("all": each node), a change gives the order new options and a new lot ("lot", a lot of the place nui_nho) and takes down what it drops, and a pause leaves the site to get old ("lost": the parts that go). Each stage of a build has its means ("means"): how the people of the time built (World.Method.means/0); what no source gives is in "means_estimate".

vietcatholic.title: Thăm tượng đài Kitô Vua trên đỉnh Tao Phùng, Vũng Tầu

grandart.title: Dừng chân ghé thăm tượng Chúa Kitô Vua

ashui.title: Tượng chúa Kitô trên đỉnh núi Nhỏ, TP Vũng Tàu

facts.text: A first statue, 10 m on a base of 5 m, was started in 1972 at Nghinh Phong (Ô Quắn). The work stopped on 17 January 1973 (the land was claimed by Buddhists); on 16 February 1974 an agreement gave the Catholics about 10 hectares on Núi Nhỏ, and the first statue was taken down.

The local government gave the permit 140/VT/HC/LA to build the statue on Núi Nhỏ (Tao Phùng), and the work started. The hill is about 170 to 176 m over the sea; the design changed for the wind and the sun of the hill.
The concrete was the work of the engineer Nguyễn Quảng Đức (ashui.com gives Nguyễn Văn Đức); the sculpture was the work of the sculptor Văn Nhân with about 50 skilled workers ("50 thợ lành nghề").
The foundation was to be 6 m deep; at about 3 m the workers found very hard concrete: tunnels of the French time under the top of the hill.
Sand and gravel from the Đồng Nai river, marble from Hòn Non Nước (Đà Nẵng), white cement from abroad; the other materials from Vietnam.
The biggest difficulty was to move thousands of tonnes of materials to the top of the hill ("Khó khăn lớn nhất là việc chuyển hàng ngàn tấn vật liệu lên đỉnh núi").

In the repair the materials went up the hill on a steep, narrow path, with no motor vehicle to help ("vận chuyển vật liệu xây dựng lên núi trong điều kiện đường dốc hẹp, không có phương tiện cơ giới hỗ trợ").
The high hill, the rock and a scaffold that was hard to set up made the work long.
The rough structure ("phần thô") was done when the work stopped on 30 April 1975.
The site was left for about 17 years: weeds covered it, and the copper cable of the lightning rod was stolen. In 1990 the city refused a first request to repair it (31 August 1990).
The province gave the permit 233/QĐ.UB to repair and finish the statue and its base with no change of the design, and a stone stair 3 to 5 m wide from the beach of Nghinh Phong, and trees.

The repair took about two years: the four reliefs of the base (the Last Supper, the three Magi, the keys to Peter, Christ before Pilate), a Pietà in front of the statue, trees, power and water, and a path of about 800 stone steps. Văn Nhân, too old to climb, directed his students from the foot of the hill. A committee led by Đa Minh Nguyễn Chu Trinh ran the work, with money and work from Catholics in Vietnam and abroad.
The bishop of Xuân Lộc, Nguyễn Minh Nhật, blessed and opened the statue on 1 December 1994. The sources do not agree: en.wikipedia gives 2 December 1994; other pages give 1993 or 1995.
Inside, a spiral stair of 133 steps goes up to the shoulders; the inside holds about 100 people at one time. Three windows in the robe give light and air.

stages.name: first_build
stages.estimate: The month of the start in 1972, and how much of the first statue was built before the stop (the base and the lower half of the statue), have no source.
stages.text: The first statue, 10 m on a base of 5 m, at the cape of Nghinh Phong.
stages.options_estimate: The sizes of the first statue have no source but the facts: 10 m on a base of 5 m (the figure of 8.6 m and the dome of 1.4 m make the 10 m, as the 27.5 m and the dome of the statue of Núi Nhỏ make its 32 m; the base of 3.8 m and the plinth of 1.2 m make the 5 m).
stages.means_estimate: No source says how the loads went up the scaffold or how the concrete was mixed in 1972 to 1975: the people carry the materials up the path (the fact carry: no source names a machine or a road for trucks to the top), mix the concrete by hand on a board, and lift the buckets with a pulley on the scaffold; the scaffold of bamboo and the forms of timber are the common means of a site of Việt Nam of the time (an estimate).

stages.name: first_pause
stages.text: The work stops: the land is claimed by Buddhists. The part that is built stands.

stages.name: first_down
stages.estimate: The days that the taking down took have no source; the sources give the day of the agreement.
stages.text: The agreement gives the cape to the Buddhists: the first statue is taken down.

stages.name: rough
stages.text: The foundation, the base, the plinth and the cast of the statue: the rough structure.
stages.means_estimate: No source says how the loads went up the scaffold or how the concrete was mixed in 1972 to 1975: the people carry the materials up the path (the fact carry: no source names a machine or a road for trucks to the top), mix the concrete by hand on a board, and lift the buckets with a pulley on the scaffold; the scaffold of bamboo and the forms of timber are the common means of a site of Việt Nam of the time (an estimate).
stages.estimate: The forms come off when their band has set (strip_N); the scaffold stays on the rough statue in the pause, for the finish (an estimate: no source says).

stages.name: pause
stages.text: No work: the rough statue stands on the hill and gets old; weeds cover the site; the copper cable of the lightning rod is stolen.
lost: the copper cable of the lightning rod

stages.name: finish
stages.text: The repair, the render, the reliefs of the base, the rail, the paths.
stages.means_estimate: The materials went up the path with no motor vehicle (the fact carry_1992). How the loads went up the scaffold has no source: a pulley, as in 1974 (an estimate).

changes.text: The order changes: the site goes from the cape of Nghinh Phong to the top of Núi Nhỏ, and the statue from 10 m on a base of 5 m to 32 m on a base of 4 m, with a design for the wind and the sun of the hill. What was built at the cape is taken down.

path.from: the foot of the hill near the beach of Nghinh Phong, where the road ends
path.estimate: No source gives the path of 1974: the points of the game of a path from the foot of the hill (6 m over the sea, at the beach of Nghinh Phong where the stone stair of 1992 starts, the fact permit_1992) to the lot on the top, in turns on the steep part.
